description: Wave 4b: ticket auth. Auth service (tools/olife/auth_service.py, HTTPS with a self-signed cert, accounts/bans from the supervisor DB) issues short one-time tickets (HMAC per gateway, <= 60 s); bots fetch them over HTTPS from VoxelCore 0.32 (network.request, verify_ssl=false + request sealed to the pinned x25519 key) and log in with the ticket in Hello.token. Then tools/olife/ticket_check.py: good -> Welcome (+PacksChanged), replayed -> 15, expired -> 14, wrong gateway -> 17, bad signature -> 16, malformed -> 4, banned account: no ticket from the service and a minted one -> 5, bad token -> refused; gateway and world alive, replication consistent.
